lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 18 — In Corinth / Priscilla, Aquila and Apollos

questions.questionText: After this, Paul left Athens and went to where?
I am a Jew from Pontus who had recently come from Italy with my wife Priscilla. Who am I?
Why had Aquila and Priscilla left Italy?
options: Because Claudius had ordered all Jews to leave Rome

questions.questionText: Paul stayed and worked with them because they were what?
Every Sabbath he reasoned in the synagogue, trying to persuade whom?
When Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, Paul devoted himself exclusively to what?
options: Preaching, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Messiah

questions.questionText: When they opposed Paul and became abusive, he shook out his clothes and said what?
options: Your blood be on your own heads! I am innocent of it. From now on I will go to the Gentiles

questions.questionText: Then Paul left the synagogue and went next door to the house of whom?
options: Titius Justus, a worshiper of God

questions.questionText: I am the synagogue leader and I and my entire household believed in the Lord. Who am I?
Many of the Corinthians who heard Paul believed and were what?
One night the Lord spoke to Paul in a vision: Do not be afraid; keep on speaking. Why?
options: For I am with you, and no one is going to attack and harm you, because I have many people in this city

questions.questionText: So Paul stayed in Corinth for how long teaching them the word of God?
I am proconsul of Achaia. The Jews made a united attack on Paul and brought him to my court. Who am I?
Gallio said if it were a matter of wrongdoing I would be justified. But since it is a question about words and names and your own law, what?
options: Paul must leave at once by my order named first

questions.questionText: So he drove them off. Then the crowd there turned on whom?
True or false: Gallio showed no concern whatever.
options: True — he became a believer that hour

questions.questionText: Paul left the brothers and sailed for Syria, taking Priscilla and Aquila. In Cenchreae he had his hair cut off because of what?
They arrived at Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He himself went into the synagogue. When they asked him to spend more time, what did he do?
options: He declined but said I will come back if it is God’s will
He stayed three years at once in this verse

questions.questionText: He set sail from Ephesus, landed at Caesarea, went up and greeted the church, then went down to where?
After spending some time in Antioch, Paul traveled from place to place throughout which region?
I am a learned Jew from Alexandria with a thorough knowledge of the Scriptures. Who am I?
Apollos had been instructed in the way of the Lord and spoke with great fervor. He knew only whose baptism?
Who invited Apollos to their home and explained the way of God more adequately?
When Apollos wanted to go to Achaia, the brothers wrote to the disciples there. In Achaia he vigorously refuted whom?
options: His Jewish opponents in public debate

questions.questionText: Apollos proved from the Scriptures that Jesus was whom?
I am from Pontus and I make tents. Who am I?
I am Aquila’s wife and I helped teach Apollos. Who am I?
Apollos was a native of where?
True or false: Apollos spoke with great fervor and taught about Jesus accurately, though he knew only John’s baptism.
options: True — but he refused to learn more

questions.questionText: I am another synagogue leader beaten in front of Gallio. Who am I?
Paul had his hair cut at which port?
I ordered all Jews to leave Rome. Who am I?
I live next door to the synagogue and I worship God. Who am I?
True or false: Many Corinthians believed and were baptized.
options: True — but Paul left the same day

questions.questionText: Who said in a vision that he had many people in this city?
Silas and Timothy came to Paul from where?
Apollos was a great help to those who had believed by grace. Where?
True or false: Paul stayed a year and a half in Corinth.
After Caesarea Paul greeted the church and went down to which home base?
Who strengthened all the disciples in Galatia and Phrygia?
